ann.t: Press Release — "Sundaram Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 04, 2026, titled "Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year Ended 30th September 2026".
Resignation — Sundaram Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the resignation of Mr. S. Viji, Chairman and Non-Executive Director of the Company
Outcome of Board Meeting — Sundaram Finance Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

Press Release — Sundaram Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 03, 2026, titled "Press Release related to unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30.06.2026.".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Sundaram Finance Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.
Updates — Sundaram Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'press meet with Journalists after announcement of the Audited Financial Results'.

Press Release — Sundaram Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 25, 2026, titled "Press Release relating to the Audited Financial Results for the year ended 31st March 2026".

Outcome of Board Meeting — Sundaram Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the proposal to raise additional Tier 2 capital by issuance of subordinated Non-Convertible Debentures on private placement basis.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Sundaram Finance Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the audited financial results for the year ended March 31, 2026.

Updates — Sundaram Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ''interaction of the KMP with journalists at a press meet to be hosted on 25th May 2026 after announcement of the Audited financial results for the financial year ended 31st March 2026".

Outcome of Board Meeting — Sundaram Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the approval granted by the Board of Directors to raise funds during FY 2026-27 by issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures on a Private Placement Basis.

Press Release — Sundaram Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated February 2, 2026, titled "Press Release related to unaudited financial results for the quarter and nine months ended 31.12.2025""

Outcome of Board Meeting — Sundaram Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the approval granted by the Board of Directors to revise the limit for raising funds, during the financial year 2025-26, by issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures on private placement basis.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Sundaram Finance Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025.
Updates — Sundaram Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2025'.
